text:
maya: kicking off weighted shift to green for router-prod at 09:45 PT. plan: 10% -> 50% over 20m -> 100% over 40m. committing sha ab12f3. quiet window 10m.

deploy-bot: starting shift: router-prod v2.1.4 -> v2.2.0, initial weight 10%, step +5% every 2m. tracking: rollout-id 2026-03-21-3123456789.

evan: quick heads-up — KV-cache miss rate on green is higher in the canary. small spike in misses after 5m. grafana: https://grafana.rw/sg/abc123 (short)

maya: noted. @sre-oncall can you check tail latencies and cache hit patterns?

sre-oncall: seeing p95 +80ms on green vs blue at 10%. p50 stable. cache hit ratio on green ~0.86 so far. will monitor. recommend prefill before pushing more weight.

raul: prefill job ETA ~6m per pool with current throughput. we can parallelize but adds load.

maya: ok let's pause at 20% and run a prefill on green. if prefill not done in 10m we pin back to blue and abort shift.

deploy-bot: paused rollout at 20% as requested. current weights: blue 80 / green 20.

evan: kicking off prefill job now. runbook snippet:
```
k8s exec -n infra kv-prefill --target=green --threads=8
```

sre-oncall: prefill started, replication lag nominal. recommending a quick probe after prefill to validate hit-rate.

maya: run the probe after prefill — 200 synthetic small requests, expect >=95% hits. @evan can you run?

evan: probe running... results: 200 reqs -> 178 cache hits (89%). lower than expected.

raul: 89% is concerning. could be key-prefix mapping differences between v2.1.4 and v2.2.0 (quantization changed keys).

maya: options: 1) continue and accept higher origin load transiently, 2) pin/rollback to blue to avoid user impact. leaning to pin. objections?

sre-oncall: I vote pin — avoid tail latency risk during peak.

maya: ok final call: pin to blue and abort traffic shift. deploy-bot, roll routing back.

deploy-bot: executing pin -> routing restore to blue (v2.1.4). applying weights... done. current weights: blue 100 / green 0. Rollout aborted.

maya: filing short release note and follow-up action items. will create post-check ticket to fix prefill + key mapping. :white_check_mark:

evan: created INFRA-789: "kv-prefill: align key-prefixes for quantized variants + probe harness" and linked to thread.

raul: thanks all — we'll re-run a dry-run tomorrow in low-traffic hours and validate probe harness first. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: monitoring continues for next 30m, will alert if any regressions show up.

maya: thanks team — closing thread, moving notes to release-notes/3123456789 in docs.
